question: What is the value of 12 - 8 ÷ 2 - {16 of -2 + 3 × 5 - 4}?
solution:
**Given:**

12 - 8 ÷ 2 - {16 of -2 + 3 × 5 - 4}

**Formula used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e54636ed411e889d1916f3aa2f06c5b9166f427a3a8425c3cbc9a3f3f9273545.png] 

**Calculation:**

Using the BODMAS rule,

12 - 8 ÷ 2 - {16 of -2 + 3 × 5 - 4}

⇒ 12 - 4 - { -32 + 15 - 4}

⇒ 12 - 4 + 21

⇒ 29

** ∴ The value of 12 - 8 ÷ 2 - {16 × -2 + 3 × 5 - 4} is 29.**
